methodology: Phase 1 (days 1-3): threat model of the treasury module, listing every cross-contract call and its callback. Phase 2 (days 4-12): line-by-line manual review focused on NEAR async execution: state changed before a promise, missing #[private] on callbacks, unchecked promise results, and storage staking. Phase 3 (days 13-16): property tests and fuzzing of the withdrawal and allowance paths in near-workspaces. Phase 4 (days 17-20): written report with severity ratings, then one free retest of fixes within 30 days.
track_record: Audited 14 NEAR contracts since 2022, including two DAO treasury modules. Public reports are listed at github.com/vendor-a/audits. Found and disclosed a callback re-entrancy bug in a lending protocol (report 11).
